title: The room that stayed open

sources.title: Behind the photograph
sources.text: Our first Saturday reading circle, 1998. Six chairs, twelve children. We took turns. The person behind the camera is not named.

sources.title: An unsigned letter
sources.text: Please leave the lamp by the window. When it is lit, the children know the reading room is open. I have repaired the radio, but the clock still stops at four. This letter has no date or signature.

sources.title: A visitor remembers
sources.text: I remember listening to the radio before we read aloud. We called it the Saturday room. I do not remember who first opened it. Years later I taught my own children to read using the books we kept.

openQuestions: Who first opened the reading room?
